shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && echo '---' && find pages -maxdepth 2 -type f -print && echo '---' && sed -n '1,200p' pages/index.tsx && echo '---' && sed -n '1,200p' pages/about.tsx && echo '---' && sed -n '1,200p' pages/_app.tsx"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' pages/_document.tsx && echo '--- docs dir ---' && find node_modules/next/dist/docs -maxdepth 3 -type f | head -n 80"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating/app-router-migration.md && echo '---' && sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/layout.md && echo '---' && sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/page.md && echo '---' && sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/03-layouts-and-pages.md"

/bin/bash -lc "mkdir -p app/about && apply_patch <<'PATCH' *** Begin Patch *** Add File: app/about/page.tsx +import Link from 'next/link' +import type { Metadata } from 'next' + +export const metadata: Metadata = { + title: 'About Us', + description: 'Learn more about us', +} + +export default function About() { + return ( +

  • + Contact +
    • +
+
+
+ ) +} *** End Patch PATCH"

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Delete File: pages/index.tsx
*** End Patch
PATCH
apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Delete File: pages/about.tsx
*** End Patch
PATCH
apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Delete File: pages/_app.tsx
*** End Patch
PATCH
apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Delete File: pages/_document.tsx
*** End Patch
PATCH
rmdir pages"
/bin/bash -lc "find . -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort && echo '---' && npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && echo '---' && git diff -- app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/about/page.tsx tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "[ -d pages ] && echo 'pages exists' || echo 'pages removed'; nl -ba app/layout.tsx; echo '---'; nl -ba app/page.tsx; echo '---'; nl -ba app/about/page.tsx; echo '---'; git diff -- package.json | sed -n '1,200p'"
/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba tsconfig.json | sed -n '1,220p' && echo '---' && nl -ba package.json | sed -n '1,220p'"

/bin/bash -lc "echo '--- HEAD package.json ---' && git show HEAD:package.json && echo '--- WORKTREE package.json ---' && cat package.json && echo '--- git diff package.json ---' && git diff -- package.json | sed -n '1,220p'"
